QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Prophecy
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra wants to talk to you...for some reason.
QuestInfo.1:
Cassandra seems to think some historic event is about to occur in Maple World, but what could it be? She also hinted that the outcome may hinge on your training.

#b[Complete all story quests up to Lv. 75 for each job to proceed to the new story quest, The Birth of an Alliance. (The Explorer does not have a separate story quest.)]#k

#b[Once you join the Alliance, you can learn the Willpower of the Alliance skill, a new passive skill that will allow you to gain the Member of the Alliance Emblem.]

#b[You will only be able to access the Silent Crusade and Arkarium quests after joining the Alliance.]

0.0: Took you long enough to come back and see me, #h0#! I bet you were excited when I wanted to talk to you. Well hear me out, cause I've got some news for you. My Crystal Ball told me that you, of all people, have a big part to play in the coming days of Maple World.
0.1: #bYou are going to play a big role in the future of Maple World!#k Not long from now, we're all going to be hoping you aren't just some flash-in-the-pan warrior.
0.2: Lucky for us, we've still got a little while before you're actually important. #rSo just leave us all alone and finish up your current duties.#k

1.0: A new dawn is coming for Maple World! It's going to be exciting and scary! I just wish you weren't the one we were all pinning our hopes on.
